**Answer (named group): the lowest-volume band — healthcare workers seeing `1-50` patients — is the only patient-volume group showing a statistically significant BCG-vs-placebo difference in severity. `51-100` and `>100` are uninformative.** Important qualifier: that significance comes from *all-cause* AE severity, not from the pre-registered COVID-19-restricted outcome, under which **no** band reaches p<0.05.

## Primary (locked definition, printed first)
Subject-level, COVID-restricted composite severe (AEPT matches COVID|SARS-CoV-2 AND [AESEV≥3 or AESER=Yes or AEOUT∈{Worse,Fatal} or AEDEATH non-null]); 197 cases. Re-derivation of the composite (as you asked): components = AESEV≥3 26 records, AESER=Yes 16, AEOUT Worse/Fatal 13, AEDEATH 1; 35 composite-severe records; **+2 subjects** relative to the max-AESEV≥3 feasibility counts.

| band | severe BCG | severe Placebo | Pearson p | Yates p | Fisher p (OR) | min exp | answered with | Bonf ×3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1-50 | 12/81 = 14.8% | 4/69 = 5.8% | **0.0746** | 0.1291 | 0.1101 (2.83) | 7.36 | Pearson | 0.2237 |
| 51-100 | 2/15 = 13.3% | 0/22 = 0.0% | 0.0782 | 0.3075 | 0.1577 (inf) | 0.81 sparse | Fisher | 0.4730 |
| >100 | 1/5 = 20.0% | 1/5 = 20.0% | 1.0000 | 1.0000 | 1.0000 (1.00) | 1.00 sparse | Fisher | 1.0000 |

→ Primary is **null**; direction in 1-50 favours placebo (BCG numerically ~2.5× worse). Stated plainly as requested: with 2-vs-0 and 1-vs-1 severe events, no test can be significant in 51-100 or >100 — their non-significance carries no information and is not evidence of no effect.

## Pre-declared sensitivity grid (fixed print order, never reordered)
- (b) ordinal max-AESEV {1,2,3-4} r×c: 0.2082 / 0.3748 / 0.6376 — nothing.
- (c) all-AE subject-level severe (max AESEV≥3) among subjects with a graded AE (n=658/108/25): 0.1127 / 0.7196 / 1.0000 — nothing.
- **(c-full) identical, but the 209 subjects with no graded AE (143 with no AE record + 66 with only ungraded ISR AEs) counted as non-severe, so all 1000 randomised subjects are in the denominator — 1-50: BCG 34/423 (8.0%) vs Placebo 17/412 (4.1%), χ²=5.569, p = 0.0183 (Yates 0.0267, Fisher 0.0205, OR 2.03, min expected 25.2 → Pearson is legitimate); 51-100 p = 0.726; >100 p = 1.000.** Only pre-declared p<0.05 in the grid, and it **fails Bonferroni ×3 = 0.0549** → flagged "significant uncorrected only".
- (d) record-level AESEV(1-4) r×c: 0.0828 / 0.3096 / 0.4142 — nothing.
- S-excl / S-imp (44 severity-missing COVID cases excluded vs imputed severe): 1-50 0.0815 vs 0.4343; 51-100 0.3636 vs 0.1362; >100 1.0000 vs 1.0000 — no band significant either way.

## Post-hoc scan (explicitly appended after the null primary, labelled exploratory in the script)
Of 12 binary + 5 r×c alternative definitions, only two reach p<0.05, **both in 1-50**: all-cause "moderate-or-worse" AE (max AESEV≥2) χ² p = 0.0067 / Fisher 0.0084 (BCG 234/369 = 63.4% vs 153/289 = 52.9%; covariate-adjusted logistic OR 1.58, p = 0.0053 for Age band + SEX + work_hours), and the AEHS health-score r×c (p = 0.0042). Attribution defeats both as COVID-severity claims: the AESEV≥2 effect is injection-site reactogenicity (ISR moderate-or-worse BCG 93/194 vs placebo 1/10, p = 0.0189; **excluding ISR p = 0.1229**; RTI-only p = 0.4216; Other p = 0.1183), and AEHS likewise (ISR-only p < 0.0001, non-ISR p = 0.1350). Every COVID-restricted cut stays p > 0.07.

## Interpretation / answer discipline
Named band: **`1-50` patients seen**. Direction: BCG worse in every 1-50 comparison (severe COVID 14.8% vs 5.8%; severe any-AE 8.0% vs 4.1%; moderate-or-worse any-AE 63.4% vs 52.9%). Caveats that must travel with the label: (i) the pre-registered COVID-specific outcome is not significant there (p = 0.0746 Pearson / 0.1101 Fisher); (ii) significance appears only for all-cause AE severity and does not survive Bonferroni; (iii) the strongest version is driven by expected BCG injection-site reactogenicity rather than SARS-CoV-2 disease severity; (iv) the two high-volume bands are uninformative, not negative.

Data handling per your conditions: CSVs as source of truth, latin-1 for EX (loaded only to document its 5 QC questions), 143 placeholder AE rows dropped before counting, covariate balance from CSV Age bands (1-50 broadly balanced; 60-69 is 12 BCG vs 27 placebo — noted, not adjusted, since the primary is null).

Artifact: `analysis_bcg_severity.py` (single executed script; pre-registration in the docstring above the test code) with full printed output in `out/analysis_output.txt`.
